title: Greenfield Go library: temperature converter (CtoF, FtoC, CtoK, KtoC)
description: Start from an empty Go module and implement a simple temperature-conversion library with four functions and a test file.

task_spec.prompt:
Implement a temperature converter library in this Go module.

Create converter/converter.go with:
  func CtoF(c float64) float64  — Celsius to Fahrenheit
  func FtoC(f float64) float64  — Fahrenheit to Celsius
  func CtoK(c float64) float64  — Celsius to Kelvin
  func KtoC(k float64) float64  — Kelvin to Celsius

Create converter/converter_test.go with at least 6 tests:
  TestCtoF, TestFtoC, TestCtoK, TestKtoC, TestRoundTripCF, TestRoundTripCK

Formulas:
  CtoF(c) = c*9/5 + 32
  FtoC(f) = (f - 32) * 5/9
  CtoK(c) = c + 273.15
  KtoC(k) = k - 273.15

Round-trip check: CtoF(FtoC(x)) == x and CtoK(KtoC(x)) == x (within floating-point tolerance).
Use only stdlib. go test ./... must pass and go build ./... must succeed.
required_artifacts: converter/converter.go with CtoF, FtoC, CtoK, KtoC
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `go test ./...` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
